{{Top|leg}}
'''Soft to Solid''' was a [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] [[Force power/Legends|Force technique]] that made normally soft parts of the body become incredibly rigid and rough for a brief amount of time, giving the user a form of natural body armor. Novices would find it difficult to maintain while an adept practitioner could keep up the technique as if it were second nature. [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] briefly used this power to defend himself from melee attacks from the crew of the ''[[Woebegone]]'' after he had decided to kill them all and take the ship as his means of transport.<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
